paragraphs: On Sunday afternoon, Dad made a small barbecue in the garden. Tom and Lily stood next to him, and Pip sat under a tree. The air was warm, and the garden was quiet. "Today we will make toast pizza," said Dad. "It is easy, and it has five steps." "Does it include olives?" asked Tom. "I love olives!" "Yes, but not on every piece, because Lily does not like them," said Dad. "I prefer cheese," said Lily.

"Step one," said Dad. "Put four slices of bread on the barbecue and cook them for two minutes." "Step two: turn the bread over." "Be careful, because the barbecue is very hot." "Stand behind the line on the ground." "How will we know when the toast is ready?" asked Lily. "It will be golden on both sides," said Dad.

"Step three," said Dad. "Put the toast on a plate and spread tomato sauce with a spoon." Lily spread the sauce on all four pieces. "Step four: put cheese on top," said Dad. "Add olives to two pieces only." Tom put six olives on his piece, and Lily put no olives on hers. "Step five: put the pizza back on the barbecue for three minutes," said Dad. "The cheese will melt, and it will smell wonderful."

Mom came out of the kitchen with a bowl of red strawberries. "This is our dessert," she said. "Please wash the strawberries and put them on a plate." "I will slice them with the knife," said Mom. "The strawberries come from the north," she said. "They were at a good price at the market." Tom washed the strawberries, and Lily put them on a plate. Mom sliced them into thin pieces, and she put a little cream on top.

Soon the toast pizza was ready, and the cheese was soft. Everybody sat at the garden table. Tom ate his olives first, and Lily ate her pieces with extra cheese. "This is the best toast ever," said Tom with a full mouth. "The pizza was easy because the steps were clear," said Lily. Dad smiled and said, "Next Sunday, you will cook, and I will watch." Pip looked at the plate and said, "Woof!"
text.summary: Dad gives five steps for a toast pizza on the barbecue. Tom and Lily follow the steps, and then Mom brings strawberries for dessert.
